p.i: Hæc animis potior si stat sententia vestris,
Sed quum aduersa trahāt Gallorum fata nepotes,

main_text.head: LECTII RESPONSIO.
main_text.p:
LEcta relecta tuus quæ Condæoque mihiq;
Candor sacrauit carmina.
Carmina nectareum mihi quæ testantur amorem,
Heroa luctu quæ colant.
Perge in amore mei, sed finem impone dolori
Luctúmque muta gaudio.
Viuere eum, fido si quicquam credis amico,
Eum valere nuntio.
Sine quod optatam sæuos lusura Tyrannos,
Mentita fama erat necem,
Fama, malum magno quæ quondam dura Maroni
Quandoque quid gignit boni.
Vati parca pio seu cessit victa, scelusque
Perosa vitam reddidit.
Quicquid id est, talem non vnquā incessere famam
Tuum iuuabit Lectium.
Quæ dedit vt magni magnum mihi pignus amoris
Mystes verendus adderet.

page.notes: The initial L of the first stanza is a large decorative initial; the first line of the stanza is transcribed as printed, with the initial letter joined to its word. Lines of the first stanza are read with some uncertainty ("Ecta relecta", "Condæoque mihiq;"). The ornament below the text is a printer's fleuron and is not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse page is present and omitted.
